purpose: Compare class-specific post-ownership strategies without changing claim-first authority or confusing preclaim waste with strategy causality.

historical_context.lesson: The universal post-ownership pattern failed reproduction and its global 10-point score was materially confounded by preclaim collisions/no-allocation. Preserve useful component evidence; do not propagate the retired pattern.

authority_boundary.rule: The experiment may choose only among already-authorized, grounded, comparably useful post-ownership next actions. It never grants authority and never justifies lower-value or fabricated work.

enrollment.trigger: first mappable owned job after durable authority exists
enrollment.seed: parseInt(first 8 hexadecimal chars of beacon_commit_sha,16) modulo variant_count
enrollment.missing_seed: DO_NOT_ENROLL; continue normal worker behavior and record experiment_enrolled=false
enrollment.later_different_job_class: Continue normal baseline behavior for that unit; only units matching the enrolled job_class may be marked experimental_slot=true.

job_classification.guide_role_override: Any won GUIDE_ROLE_PIN_CREATE maps to GUIDE_FRONTIER.

variants.behavior: After the first evidence-backed productive unit, when an authorized grounded continuation exists in the same job/project and the existing max-two-consecutive-project law permits it, prefer one additional closure-oriented unit before diversifying.

After the owned job reaches its current definition-of-done checkpoint, when comparably grounded compatible work exists in another product project, prefer diversifying before taking a second same-project unit.
For the owned verification gate, prefer at most one additional independent evidence angle when it can materially change the verdict or confidence and the gate is not already decisive.
Once decisive PASS/FAIL/capability/authority-boundary evidence is durable, prefer materializing the exact residual/successor and reallocating rather than collecting redundant evidence.
Prefer consuming compatible durable returns and materializing grounded non-duplicate successors so useful frontier is replenished before optional downstream execution.
After integration unlocks one safe concrete unit, prefer executing or verifying that newly-unblocked unit before broader replenishment when authority already permits it.
When current evidence shows a repeated software-solvable systemic bottleneck, prefer one bounded mechanism repair before ordinary frontier replenishment.
Absent a safety/authority break requiring rescue, prefer creating or restoring grounded executable product/assist frontier before optional mechanism work.

terminal_exam.rule: Only evidence-backed productive slots actually governed by the assigned variant and matching the enrolled job_class may set experimental_slot=true.

measurement.causal_boundary: Preclaim diagnostics remain important system outcomes but are not attributed causally to a post-ownership variant.
measurement.class_ready_when: Both variants in the same job_class have >=3 independent workers with >=1 evidence-backed experimental slot.
measurement.guide_decision_rule: When a class is sample-ready, inspect postclaim distributions and exact receipts, account for preclaim imbalance as a confounder, then promote/reject only a class-specific law. Never infer a universal worker champion from cross-class aggregation.

rollback_or_rejection: Any preclaim read/claim/authority regression attributable to the experiment.
Workers create filler, duplicate successors or lower-value work to satisfy a variant.
Variant assignment cannot be reconstructed from durable evidence.
After a sample-ready class, exact receipts do not support a meaningful post-ownership difference.
